title: Credit Card Referral Offers and Restrictions
summary: This document explains a cross-credit-card weekly referral limit: you may receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window. Any third (and later) referral attempts within the same 7 days are automatically denied and cannot be reinstated until the rolling window drops below the cap.
